summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $1.36 M in annual savings across 14 cost categories
summary.narrative: Through a comprehensive strategic-sourcing program, Treya Partners identified $1,363,353 in recurring annual savings for Advantia Health. Six categories—ranging from Revenue-Cycle Management fees to Medical Supplies and Lab Services—are fully finalized, delivering $684,936 already in place. A further $678,417 in savings is queued across eight additional categories now in negotiation, contracting, or analysis stages, ensuring a strong pipeline for continued value capture. Key wins include a 9 % fee reduction with Athena for billing/RCM, distributor consolidation for Medical Supplies, and an insourcing model for Sonography Services.
